text:
Type: teardrop stoneware vase
Use: holding stems or as display decor; living room, dining room, bedroom, on a console, shelf or table
Style: bohemian, contemporary, coastal
Materials: glazed stoneware, glossy finish, painted pattern
Colors: dark navy blue, white
Shape: tall teardrop body with narrow neck, shibori-like white dash bands around the belly, slender
Feel: graphic, crafted, calm
Goes with: white walls, natural wood, indigo textiles, rattan; coastal or boho rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Stone & Beam Shibori Inspired Stoneware Vase, 11.6"H, Blue and White
product.description: Match this beautiful vase with a bright purple iris or a white rose and place it as a centerpiece on any table. The base diameter of just over 6" gives way to a thin decorative pillar, making this the perfect standalone vase. 6.3" diameter x 11.6"H Made from 100% stoneware for long-lasting durability Suitable for cloth flowers or blossoms straight from the garden White-on-blue Shibori styling makes this vase both eye-catching and unique. No assembly required Hand wash with a damp cloth.
